title: achillea kraettliana
intro: Achillea kraettliana, commonly known as Yarrow, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. Yarrow is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support the immune system. The plant's therapeutic actions include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which make it effective in treating wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Yarrow include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and volatile oils, such as borneol and camphor, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
